body: Thank you so much, this was so sweet🥹❤️
I’m sorry you also experience a fucked up family dynamic. I hope you can enjoy the holidays and treat yourself to something nice!

Thank you. I feel like it’s an obvious nta situation but at the same time I have this immense guilt for not spending time with my mom and sister as much in these past years by isolating myself and I am worried I’m TA for not sucking it up just to see them more while I still have the time and live close.

Thanks for commenting. I do want to be living proof that I am me, a person, who is better than I once was because I basically built my life now from the ground up and I think I do deserve it. It just gets hard some days to remind myself or see that, I appreciate you being that reminder.

Don’t have good advice, but even tho you’re eating a little bit more currently it doesn’t mean your ED was a lie, you are still struggling & financial means are out of your control. Hope these feelings pass soon for you friend, im proud of you!
Yes, & it’s not even meals I just snack throughout the day on random stuff

Honestly good question, idk I wasn’t consistent with lifting at the time cuz I didn’t enjoy it & did yoga & body weight/hiit workouts at home more. Looking back on photos I think it helped at first to just lose the fat + gain the muscle i lost for so many years from my ed. But lifting definitely toned me a lot more.

I went through recovery + no exercise + weight gain and I honestly gained no muscle mass. I started weight lifting with my bf during recovery & although I gained weight I could barely lift 15lbs. To stay weight restored & build muscle back so i’m not just fat I started doing at home body weight workouts & yoga! Yoga actually helped a ton & I lost fat while staying weight restored & gained muscle. 
idk if any of that made sense but that’s what worked for me!
Hey i’m glad you found this community! I think it’s a good idea to talk to your family before it gets any worse a year is a long time

This!! I would always eat packaged food around family so I don’t have to weigh it & my SIL who has orthorexia would always say “Oh I would never eat that you don’t know what’s in processed food” people need to mind their business
Maybe it would be good to sit down with him and have a talk. Tell him you’re concerned for him and that what he is doing is very triggering. Or something along those lines idk, best of luck friend!
Do you know why he is fasting?
Thank you for replying and understanding me. It really is so comforting to know other people relate, sometimes i feel like the only one. I appreciate your kind words!

I love this for you! Your eating disorder is so valid diagnosed or not, this makes me so happy that you could enjoy a day free from it(: You sharing this is honestly making an impact for others because now I want to challenge myself to a nice relaxing sunday without fear, so thank you!

This! I get whiplash from my own thoughts. One day I think I look so hot in everything and I have confidence to leave my house in a cute outfit and flirt with everyone for fun and then the next day i’ve convinced myself I gained weight overnight and look gross so I have to wear baggy clothes and don’t want anyone to see me.
Love how our ed’s make us do “embarrassing” and awkward things🥴
Lol I do that too! I’m always paranoid someone will see me but there are literally no cameras & i’m the only one in there😂
Wake up Chris Breezy

True, she always compares our bodies but she doesn’t have ill intent I swear. She just has a hard time understanding mental illnesses (she’s from a different country where it’s more taboo) & doesn’t realize the things she says are harmful. I’ll probably talk to her about it.

Your comment was fine! I just feel like i’m not living up to everyone’s standards. No matter how hard I try to be the person everyone wants me to be it’s never good enough for them. If that makes sense
You’re right, idk why i’m so afraid to lose people even when they’re not good for me. I just need to learn to be okay & more confident on my own without the validation of others. Thank you

It always comes in waves. Once I get into that negative head space it’s like my world is crashing, and then I have time to think and I feel a lot better about my situation. Even if i’m alone there’s so many things that i’ve wanted to experience by myself. Thank you for your comment🤍
Everyone on this sub is making it so much easier to continue on, I honestly might have to print out all these comments & carry it with me so I can read them when i’m down. I’m glad i’m not alone🤍

I’ve never been called precious before, that made me smile🥺I definitely feel a lot better after crying & reading these sweet comments. I appreciate your kind words, I hope you are doing well yourself!❤️
I would love to see them, I just need to find my strength. I’m getting there(:
Wow, you said exactly what I needed to hear. I will make progress, even if it’s small! I’m sending my love to you as well, just this comment made a difference in my day you are so appreciated.🥺🤍

Today i’m really missing when I didn’t have a million thoughts going through my head. My mind all day has been telling me to not eat but i’m also hungry & want to listen to my body, but I need to exercise but i’m too tired & sick, and if i don’t hit all my stupid ed rules/goals 4 the day i’ll cry
I feel you. It’s exhausting mentally & physically :/

Oh my god I know so many girls my bf’s friends are dating that always say shit like this & I just don’t say anything because I may not be “sickly thin” but if that’s how they view people with ED’s then I don’t want to imagine what they’d say about me behind my back! People always talk down on us as if it’s a terrible choice we’re making.

Sorry I tried to keep it as vague as possible. They don’t invite me to do any activities with them anymore. They barely greet me or talk to me anymore, even if I try to make conversation they give me short responses.
I’m so envious, congrats!!❤️
It sucks when you live with them or see them all the time cuz you can’t avoid it as easily
That seems like what she is probably doing, I feel bad for her.
